protectedMediaDemo.title: ProtectedMedia — demo
protectedMediaDemo.intro: Development page with placeholder assets. Try it: right-click, try to drag, switch tabs or click outside the window.
protectedMediaDemo.disclaimer: This is a deterrent, not a security control: no web page can stop an OS screenshot, a screen recorder or an external camera. The real protection is server-side (per-viewer forensic watermarking + audit trail); this layer only makes casual capture more awkward and keeps the trace code in frame.
protectedMediaDemo.videoNote: No real source — poster only. In production the overlay receives the traceCode that GET /api/content/:id/serve returns alongside the signed URL.
